caption: the busiest week of february: pisces season, a lunar eclipse in virgo and mars back into leo. save this.

slides.headline: *7 sky events* in *4 days*: an *eclipse*, a new season, mars into leo
the *sun* enters pisces, and mercury backs into aquarius
slides.body: the sun meets mercury the same day. pisces season starts with a rewind.

slides.headline: the sun faces *mars*: you'll want to win the argument
slides.body: earth sits between the sun and retrograde mars. astrologers read it as pride up front. ask if you're right or just loud.

slides.headline: a full moon *eclipse* in virgo, faint enough to miss
slides.body: the moon only grazes earth's outer shadow. read it as a quiet ending.

slides.headline: *mars* backs out of virgo and into leo
slides.body: still retrograde. old pride, old flames, old fights come up for review. you don't have to reopen them.

slides.headline: loud week. you can be the *calm* one.
slides.body: save this and check it each morning.
